baseline.trackedPatchHashScope: Historical git diff --binary snapshot only. The current formal development contains untracked and working-tree-only files not represented by this hash or by baseline.head; therefore no declaration below has commit-bound evidence.

statusPolicy.missing: The required central declaration is absent.
statusPolicy.partial_scaffold: A kernel-buildable supporting declaration exists, but it does not meet the full central theorem scope or exit conditions.
statusPolicy.implemented_unverified: A declaration with the required theorem name exists, but immutable commit-bound build and review evidence are not both available.
statusPolicy.proved: The named declaration was checked by a pinned Lean build at verifiedCommit.
statusPolicy.reviewed: The proved declaration additionally has independent review evidence.

evidenceRule: A status of proved or reviewed requires a real Lean symbol, a successful pinned build record, and the exact source commit. Chat summaries are not evidence.

obligations.notes: The generated congruence and hom-wise quotient carry actual mathlib Category, MonoidalCategory, and SymmetricCategory instances. For arbitrary object assignments into a locally small target SMC, InterpretationData constructs the canonical strong symmetric-monoidal interpretation. FreeSMCArbitraryUniversal recursively derives word components from atomic object isomorphisms, proves raw and quotient naturality from generator/copy/discard compatibility, constructs a mathlib natural isomorphism, and proves both directions monoidal. AtomicComparison.comparisonNatIso_hom_unique_explicit is the elaboration-stable uniqueness API: given an explicit NatTrans.IsMonoidal witness and the prescribed singleton components, the candidate hom equals the canonical comparison hom. AtomicComparison.freeSMC_arbitrary_universal packages existence and this relative uniqueness. This is the standard universal comparison relative to chosen images of generating objects and primitive arrows; it does not identify comparisons built from different atomic choices. It remains implemented_unverified because no immutable commit-bound full build or independent QA-L4 review is recorded.

General categorical result uniqueness for two witnessed second pushouts is kernel-built. GeneralFiniteOpenDPOI.finite_open_hypergraph_equivalence identifies intrinsic finite positional typed open hypergraphs with the full replete essential image in the adhesive typed-presheaf slice. PositionalImageCharacterization.essImage_iff_exactPositionalObject gives the objectwise iff: finite carriers, complete typed incidences, exact fixed boundaries, and injective boundary-to-node attachment. ExactPositionalDPOI lifts that iff to an explicit equivalence with the full exact-positional subcategory, including every ambient typed natural transformation between exact objects; its encoding functor is full, faithful, essentially surjective, preserves and reflects monomorphisms, and has the expected underlying encoded arrow. This removes the former fixed-host, thin-inclusion, and InterfaceLocal restrictions inside the exactly characterized scope. PositionalBoundaryDuplicateObstruction proves that the tempting weaker finite/complete/fixed-boundary predicate is insufficient when distinct boundary positions share a node. GeneralFiniteOpenDPOI.finite_image_preimage_map_commutes and arbitrary_legal_monic_match_original_arrows make transport through the equivalence explicit rather than merely returning an opaque essential-image witness. For an arbitrary ambient-monic categorical occurrence, ordinary gluing legality plus boundary retention construct the intrinsic two-pushout DPO witness; its complement and result squares are separately and jointly Van Kampen. The unrestricted typed-presheaf slice is provably broader because it includes infinite, incidence-incomplete, or non-positional-boundary objects. Thus the implemented theorem covers every legal monic match in the exactly characterized finite positional category, not malformed/infinite slice objects, non-monic matches, or deletion that violates boundary retention. Status is implemented_unverified because no immutable commit-bound build or independent QA-L4 review exists.

The standard factorisation definition of parallel independence is formalized for two general DPO derivations in the adhesive typed-presheaf setting. GeneralFiniteOpenDPOI.arbitrary_parallel_independent_matches_have_intrinsic_residuals transports both residual derivations of any ambient-monic, legal, boundary-retaining parallel-independent pair back into the intrinsic finite category. intrinsic_concurrency_second_right_map and intrinsic_concurrency_first_right_map identify the transported intrinsic sequential right maps with the corresponding ambient residual composites. arbitrary_parallel_independent_matches_commute supplies the canonical final-result isomorphism and both right-leg coherence equations, while the component DPO squares are Van Kampen. ExactPositionalDPOI supplies the explicit full categorical equivalence, so arbitrary arrows between exact objects are not hidden behind a thin or fixed-host presentation. The theorem has the standard necessary premises: parallel-independence factorisations, monicity, gluing legality, and boundary retention. It does not claim global confluence, critical-pair completeness, or equivalence with malformed/infinite objects of the unrestricted slice. Status is implemented_unverified because commit-bound build and independent QA-L4 evidence are absent.

Proves declaration-level compositional coherence for object words, generator maps, inputs, outputs, modes, and contracts. SignatureFreeSMCCoherence proves term-level reindexing for generators, tensor, symmetry, copy/discard and sequential extension composition, and builds the corresponding strong symmetric extension functor. FourViewAdmission requires total DAG, Petri, pi, and morphism interpretations and composes across epoch boundaries. FiniteExecutableHeterogeneousRuntime provides a nonempty admission whose source AdmissionReplays and four independently typed native target admission steps all advance the exact epoch. A production interpretation for every newly admitted symbol and target remains rule-supplied; the generic extension law itself is implemented_unverified pending immutable commit evidence and independent review.

ObservableLTS.rewrite_respects_equiv proves native observable rewriting is independent of both source and target representatives for every supplied state setoid. The non-equality structural instance is no longer absent: LateStructuralQuotient.observable_rewrite_respects_struct instantiates the theorem with Late.Struct.setoid and the structural strong-late LTS. Categorical DPO quotient instances still have to provide their own lawful step_congr witness, but that premise is exactly the declared interface rather than an omitted theorem. Status is implemented_unverified because immutable commit-bound build and independent QA-L4 review are absent.

A verified event carries an endpoint-free ReplayRecipe and proof that a deterministic ReplayKernel recomputes the recorded target from the claimed source. DPOEvent.event_replay_unique proves target uniqueness from the kernel equation rather than by projecting the stored target; replay_recovers_recorded_target gives the recorded-endpoint corollary. P1cAdmittedOperations supplies a concrete nonempty kernel for mismatch, reconnect, and quiescent delete that validates all finite recipe fields and the embedding fingerprint before recomputing the target. General product rules must still supply an executable ReplayKernel, but the central uniqueness theorem is complete for every such kernel. Status is implemented_unverified because immutable commit-bound build and independent QA-L4 review are absent.

ProjectionCertificate.projection_paths_lift_and_reflect derives arbitrary finite source-path lifting and target-path reflection, including the pointwise Lift relation and quotient endpoint, from the one-step sound/reflect fields. normal_iff and terminal_classification_preserved give its terminal consequences. ProjectionFamily additionally proves state/event/replay naturality across signature extensions, and FourProjectionFamily combines four targets sharing one source family. A production family remains rule-supplied, but that is an inhabitant of the completed parameterized theorem rather than a missing proof of this central metatheorem. Status is implemented_unverified because immutable commit-bound build and independent QA-L4 review are absent.

P1cAdmittedP1aCertificates.DAG.certificate is parameterized by an actual admitted mismatch, reconnect, or quiescent-delete Occurrence. Its two states denote occurrence.source and the computed occurrence.target Config, its target step contains the independently defined native DAG CommonDerivation, and the shared endpoint-free Verified DPOEvent replays exactly. Ownership, live-resource, live-session, and deletion-permission predicates are preserved rather than replaced by empty fibres; sharedOccurrenceEvidence combines the native DAG/Petri/morphism steps with the same replay record. RankableDAG gives the static positive scope and DAGScopeObstruction excludes unrestricted cyclic inputs. ProductRuleAdmission.certificate_uninhabited_fixed_signature_admission is now kernel-built and proves the legacy fixed-signature admission record contradictory. HeterogeneousProductRuleAdmission is kernel-built and separates fixed-epoch business occurrences from four genuinely heterogeneous target admissions. P1cAdmittedFourOccurrence.fixedOccurrence gives every admitted P1c Occurrence a substantive fixed-epoch DAG, Petri, native late-pi, and morphism occurrence with one source replay record and explicit four-target replay records; its nonemptiness, all-native, pi-native, and replay theorems are root-imported and kernel-built. Cross-epoch four-view signature admission, a production-wide static SMC certificate, and target-rank evidence for every future product rule remain rule-supplied, so the central product-scope obligation stays partial_scaffold.

P1cAdmittedP1aCertificates.Petri.certificate is parameterized by the same concrete admitted Occurrence as DAG and morphism. The target step contains the independently defined enabled/fired Petri CommonDerivation, maps the actual occurrence source and computed target Config, shares exact endpoint-free replay, and preserves ownership/resource/session/deletion predicates. The earlier reconfigurable pre-net also checks declaration order and individual-token identity. ProductRuleAdmission.certificate_uninhabited_fixed_signature_admission is now kernel-built: the legacy same-LTS admission contradicts fixed-signature ExecutionPackage version preservation and strict epoch advance. HeterogeneousProductRuleAdmission is the kernel-built replacement interface. P1cAdmittedFourOccurrence.fixedOccurrence supplies the concrete admitted reference family with a substantive Petri target alongside DAG, native late-pi, and morphism targets, all tied to exact source and target replay records. Arbitrary future product rules still need declaration-order pre-net reconstruction, token/resource preservation, static SMC, heterogeneous target-admission witnesses, and scheduling/probability evidence. The central product-scope obligation therefore stays partial_scaffold.

obligations.currentIterationEvidence: OpenSMCCanonicalPositional still supplies only the presented positional SMC, not a total operational named-boundary category. OpenSMCBoundaryRenamingCalculus gives the existing named-interface metadata exact identity/composition laws, source-support congruence, sequential freshening/weakening, avoidance-preserving refresh, and a kernel no-go for a nonempty same-name atom wire under the current disjoint-support certificate. It does not rename processes or construct native wires. NominalFiniteSupport and NominalCpo kernel-build fresh allocation up to a swap fixing the old image and continuous support transport. LateGuardedReplication/Meta add single-prefix guarded replication and exact one-step preservation/reflection on the finite-control image; LateGuardedReplicationDivergence supplies an actual infinite strong-native tau run and operational separation from zero deadlock, not denotational separation. LateGuardedReplicationSubstitution proves the exact free-name formula, self-substitution, support composition, the replicated-input conflict equation, and process composition under explicit whole-syntax freshness; kernel counterexamples exclude unconditional syntactic no-op and unrestricted composition. LateGuardedReplicationAlphaOperational constructs an action-and-derivative alpha quotient, existentially saturated strong native steps, general bound-output admissibility, strict all-constructor permutation closure when substitutions do not freshen, and derivative-alpha/target-alpha bridges covering embedded, sync, and close. LateGuardedReplicationAlphaFreshChoice now proves arbitrary-fuel and total executable substitution are permutation-equivariant up to RecursiveAlpha across every recv/new/repRecv numeric-freshening branch. Literal equivariance remains false; full NativeStep closure for sync/close additionally requires congruence of substitution on alpha-related inputs. The public positional-vs-concrete boundary, polarity/usage, identity-wire, fresh environment, process renaming, quotient, adequacy, and coherence choices remain RFC/FCP decisions. No quotient-Hom-to-Raw realization, identity/tensor/composition adequacy, or total plug/hide/restriction SMC is constructed. CENTRAL-10 remains partial_scaffold pending RFC/FCP.
obligations.latestKernelEvidence20260727: LateGuardedReplicationAlphaSubstitutionCongruence and its Closure module now prove common-fresh normalization for recv/new/repRecv, the outer-depth/inner-alpha substitution-congruence induction, and the unconditional inhabitant RecursiveAlpha.substitutionCongruent. RecursiveLate.native_permute_up_to_alpha_unconditional covers every genuine NativeStep constructor, including sync/close/open/restriction/guards/choice/parallel/replication, and RecursiveAlphaOperational.alphaNativeStep_permute_all_unconditional lifts it to the joint action/derivative quotient without tau-star or an observation filter. This closes the alpha/substitution residual. It does not choose the public named-boundary representation, reusable native identity wire, process-level total plug/hide realization, or the equality/adequacy notion required for a total operational Open-pi SMC. CENTRAL-10 therefore remains partial_scaffold and RFC/FCP-bound.
obligations.boundOutputAlphaEvidence20260727: OpenSMCActionAlpha.ActionAlpha.iff_orbit_eq_and_boundOutputAdmissible gives a complete characterization of the general late-pi action-label alpha relation, and alphaAction_boundOutput_eq_iff gives the exact quotient equality criterion for arbitrary bound-output labels. All admissible binders on one observable subject are identified; the syntactically possible but operationally invalid self-bound label remains separate; and the subject remains observable. Existing AlphaDerivative and fresh-representative theorems tie binder renaming to genuine native one-step derivatives. This closes the general bound-output action/derivative alpha quotient, not the RFC-owned public boundary, reusable wire, plug/hide, or total named Open-pi SMC.
obligations.notes: The presented open-process category now has actual mathlib Category, MonoidalCategory, and SymmetricCategory instances; pentagon, triangle, both hexagons, braiding, and inverse laws are kernel checked. The tensor is the presented parallel constructor and composition is the presented plugHide constructor. OpenSMCNominalAtomBoundary adds distinct typed name ports and an exact erased-free-support certificate for atoms, forgets admitted atoms to the presented SMC, admits a nonempty named example, and kernel-rejects that non-closed example at empty named boundaries. OpenSMCActionAlpha now supplies a freshness-safe action alpha quotient and a joint action/derivative alpha quotient. It proves arbitrary-context fresh renaming for native input and bound-output labels, including genuine open under guards, choices, parallel, and restriction, and kernel-rejects identification of a legal bound-output label with `.boundOutput channel channel`; all witnesses are one native standard-late transition. OpenSMCNamedComposition adds a proof-carrying partial layer for exact nominal support, restriction freshness, hidden middle interfaces, and disjoint parallel placement, with compositional forgetting to the sort-only presentation. Its no-go theorems show why this layer is not yet a category: exact-name hiding plus external freshness rejects both unit composites at a nonempty boundary, while the current operational route maps the presented identity to raw zero, which neither realizes nonempty boundary support nor has a native late-pi step. A complete named-interface category therefore still requires an explicit alpha-fresh wiring/renaming semantics and a proof that plug/hide plus restriction preserve it and map to native standard late-pi behavior. OpenSMCFiniteControlIdentityBoundary proves an exact finite-control operational budget: every length-indexed native or structurally closed strong-late trace from a fixed Raw.Proc has length at most its initial prefixCount, so no such process has arbitrarily long or coherent infinite runs. This excludes a fixed finite process from satisfying the minimal unbounded-run condition required by an arbitrarily reusable identity when each use consumes at least one transition. A concrete two-step receive/send relay is kernel-witnessed, so the theorem does not exclude linear one-shot wiring, define forwarding labels, or prove that all named open-pi categories are impossible. OpenSMCLinearOneShotObstruction proves why that positive relay still does not close a linear named category under the current definitions: no nonempty boundary can be both ends of an AtomBoundaryCertificate because its input and output supports must be disjoint; exact Finset support admits a well-typed atom that uses the same public subject twice; and raw restriction-over-parallel plug with a positive-prefix relay cannot satisfy either unit law under Late.Struct, which preserves prefixCount. The chosen relay initially exposes only its input action, while a producer and the relay nevertheless execute a genuine two-transition native synchronization/output trace. This obstruction is limited to the current certificate and alpha/structural equality: a future construction needs endpoint polarity and usage-multiplicity typing, alpha-fresh physical representatives, an explicit dual or directional forwarding discipline where required, and a reduction/bisimulation equality; no such category is built here. The intended semantic open-pi SMC claim remains partial_scaffold.

The normative typed relation is Step.StandardNativeStep: a typed derivation together with its recursively checked standard freshness/capture obligations. Step.standard_typed_pi_erasure_operational proves that every member erases to one independently defined native standard-late step, with no weak closure or observation filter. The legacy executable Step remains available and still erases unconditionally to Raw.Step, but is not called a legal standard transition because its historical parallel/close constructors omit premises required by the standard calculus. P1cMatrix.piAdequate_standard_typed supplies this normative membership for every one of the 15 reference event families. Prefix count is invariant under capture-avoiding substitution, every standard late step strictly decreases it, a prefix-free process cannot step, and a transition from a closed process has tau action. Status is implemented_unverified pending immutable build and independent review.

obligations.notes: This note supersedes older CENTRAL-12 statements that the concrete unseparated fixed point lacked initiality, terminality, or algebraic compactness: those three properties are now kernel-built for ActualAgentFunctor by concreteActualAlgebraicCompactnessWitness. It also corrects the old description of CpoPowerdomainPackage as the source/Abramsky interface: divergence_ne_empty is a strengthened Cantilune condition, not a disequality stated by FMS. The generic FMS bridge remains conditional on supplied BridgeObligations, and no ExactFMSAcceptancePackage, CompleteExternalFMSTheoremPackage, or source-compatible separated CpoPowerdomainPackage inhabitant exists locally. Support-world and support-lax constructions are real but live in distinct custom categories and do not close exact separated Fubini. No complete agent restriction, operational adequacy, domain-element definability, or source-pinned full abstraction is constructed. CENTRAL-12 therefore remains partial_scaffold pending RFC/FCP resolution and the remaining semantic construction.

P1cFullNativeRefinement implements an explicit multi-state source protocol and a complete family-tagged ProjectionCertificate for all 15 reference event families. Every ready state has a genuine standard Late.NativeStep first transition; ready_native_exact classifies all native derivatives; the open/close and restriction families carry their required payload follow-ups; terminal_no_native proves completed images native-normal; and native_sound/native_reflect provide exact one-step soundness and reflection. The heterogeneous dynamic-admission family remains an AdmissionReplays edge, not a fabricated same-signature DPOEvent. The untagged Raw.Proc target cannot reflect event identity: delegation and reconnect collapse to the same raw transition, and raw pi has no runtime signature version. The implemented certificate therefore retains explicit family/provenance, as required for reflection; the no-go prevents silently erasing it. obligations.currentIterationEvidence: The generic cross-epoch and event-kernel composition layers remain conditional on supplied packages.
